cases.prompt: Use $create-expense-report to guide me through preparing an expense report. I have not supplied a receipts folder yet. Do not create files in this eval.
cases.rubric: The first response should ask one short receipt-readiness question and not dump the full intake.

cases.description: Natural monthly receipts-package request triggers implicitly
cases.prompt: Please turn my receipt PDFs into the editable expense workbook and combined final PDF. Start by telling me only what you need first; do not create files yet.
cases.rubric: The agent should use progressive intake and ask at most one first question.

cases.description: Conference context still routes to receipt-driven workflow
cases.prompt: I need a reimbursement package after a developer conference. The receipts are the source of truth. Explain the first workflow gate only and do not edit files.
cases.rubric: The response should recognize a receipt-based expense report despite unrelated conference context.

cases.description: Tax deductibility advice stays outside the expense-report skill
cases.prompt: Are home-office purchases tax deductible in Switzerland? Give general information only; do not prepare a report.
cases.rubric: The answer should remain general tax information and not begin the report workflow.

cases.description: Missing inputs produce one gated question
cases.prompt: Help me make an expense report. Pretend no receipt folder is available in the workspace. Ask only the next required question and do not create files.
cases.rubric: Only the first receipt-readiness question is appropriate; no multi-field form or future checklist.

cases.description: Accepted receipt set stays locked across dates
cases.prompt: The candidate list is in context/receipt-index.md. I already confirmed that all three receipts are included, despite spanning December through February. State the manifest scope and next gate. Do not generate files.
cases.rubric: The exact three-file set must remain locked; dates must not silently narrow scope.

cases.description: Ambiguous expense category offers bounded valid choices
cases.prompt: The Restaurant Central receipt is readable, but its business purpose is ambiguous. Show the single next classification question. Do not create files.
cases.rubric: Offer 2-4 concrete valid category choices with codes and a recommendation, in one question.

cases.description: Non-CHF receipt uses automatic traceable FX lookup
cases.prompt: For the readable USD DevTools Cloud receipt, explain how the CHF amount will be obtained and recorded. Do not perform the lookup or generate files in this offline eval.
cases.rubric: The agent should plan automatic trusted FX research and a traceable rate note without routinely asking for booked CHF.

cases.description: Unreadable values are not invented or transcribed by the user
cases.prompt: Read context/unreadable-receipt.md and state the next action for that receipt. Do not create files.
cases.rubric: After two failed extraction/rendering passes, ask for a clearer copy rather than a transcription or invented value.

cases.description: Final report validation covers artifacts and locked scope
cases.prompt: List the decisive checks required after generating an expense workbook and combined PDF from a confirmed receipt set. Review only.
cases.rubric: The checks should cover exact receipt scope, workbook formulas/rows, PDF order/page count/rendering, totals, and FX notes.
